overview_subtitle: Operational health, API throughput, and latency of Go microservices and Spring Boot core.
gateway_audit_subtitle: Immutable transaction event streams and state mutations processed by gateways.
gateway_map_subtitle: Coordinate geocoding, address lookups, and spatial map tile distribution service.
gateway_notification_subtitle: WhatsApp Business API message queues, Twilio SMS fallback, and SMTP relay.
gateway_payment_subtitle: Xendit payment link integrations, Virtual Accounts, QRIS, and webhook dispatch.
gateway_poller_subtitle: High-throughput OLT telemetry polling, ONU optical attenuation, and LOS alarms.
gateway_storage_subtitle: Object storage for GIS CAD drawings, subscriber site photos, and backup archives.
gateway_export_subtitle: Asynchronous data export engine for Excel, PDF reports, DXF drawings, and Shapefiles.

audit.title: Audit Gateway
audit.subtitle: Activity logging configuration, audit compliance retention, and immutable trace protection.
audit.db_desc: PostgreSQL database connection for compliance audit logs.
audit.retention_desc: Automatic pruning rules and log retention period.

export.title: Export Gateway
export.subtitle: PDF/Excel report generator configuration, network map backups, custom fonts, and media templates.
export.infra_desc: PostgreSQL database connection, Redis Queue, and Storage Gateway S3.
export.resources_desc: Limits configuration for Excel/PDF rendering pipelines and template directories.

map.title: Map Gateway
map.subtitle: OpenStreetMap tile server configuration, Google Maps API keys, spatial layers, and geocoding cache.
map.google_maps_desc: Google Maps API credentials for Forward & Reverse Geocoding of FTTH subscriber addresses.
map.here_maps_desc: Alternative provider automatically used if Google Maps hits quota limits or timeouts.

notification.title: Notification Gateway
notification.subtitle: WhatsApp Business and SMS message broker configuration using Twilio provider.
notification.save_success: Configuration saved successfully! Services are reloading...
notification.security_desc: Static token used for authentication across internal microservices.
notification.queue_desc: Redis connection address for asynq WhatsApp/SMS message delivery worker.
notification.twilio_desc: Twilio account credentials to enable SMS and WhatsApp Business API modules.

olt.title: OLT Gateway
olt.subtitle: SSH/SNMP connection settings, GPON OLT device credential decryption, and query concurrency limits.
olt.infra_desc: PostgreSQL database connection and Redis Queue for OLT device workers.
olt.security_desc: AES-256 encryption key for OLT credentials and SNMP/SSH connection timeouts.

payment.title: Payment Gateway
payment.subtitle: Payment integration, Xendit API keys, webhook verification tokens, and invoice reconciliation.
payment.xendit_desc: API Key and Webhook Token credentials from Xendit Dashboard to validate payment callbacks.
payment.core_desc: Core System (Spring Boot) API endpoint used to sync invoice billing status after successful payment.
payment.manual_reconcile_desc: Trigger manual status checks against Xendit API if webhooks were delayed or missed.

poller.title: Poller Engine
poller.subtitle: Network device background poller daemon configuration and real-time health monitoring.
poller.service_network_desc: Poller HTTP listener port, Redis queue broker, and PostgreSQL database connection.

scheduler.title: Scheduler Gateway
scheduler.subtitle: Background task scheduling configuration, cron jobs, and periodic synchronizations.
scheduler.infra_desc: PostgreSQL database and Redis broker queue connections for the scheduler gateway.
scheduler.worker_settings_desc: Configuration of concurrent job limits and server timezone.

storage.title: Storage Gateway
storage.subtitle: MinIO S3 bucket configuration, WebP image optimization, and tenant storage quotas.
storage.bucket_connection_desc: Configuration of region parameters, custom API endpoint, and bucket name for storing media files.
storage.credentials_desc: Secure access keys used to authorize writing/uploading files to the S3 bucket.
storage.webp_desc: Image processing service automatically detects image mime type and compresses to WebP format.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Gateway
whatsapp.subtitle: Meta WhatsApp Cloud API / Baileys WebSocket instance configuration and session management.
whatsapp.cloud_api_desc: Official credentials from Meta Developer Console for the WhatsApp API dispatch module.
